topics.answer: Raigad was developed under the direction of Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj, with architect Hiroji Indulkar shaping its remarkable capital complex.
On June 6, 1674, Shivaji Maharaj was crowned Chhatrapati at Raigad, establishing it as the capital of the Maratha Empire.
Look for the Maha Darwaja: its steep approach was designed so an approaching army could never see how the fort opened beyond it.
